steps.action: A failed Task write leaves the earlier Description saved and the retry succeeds
steps.actual: One injected 503 on the Tasks write produced "The template Tasks could not be saved. Earlier changes may already be saved.". The earlier Description had already saved (stored "Independent partial-save probe IND81T2F") while the Tasks list still read ["Confirm scope with the requester (revised)","Open the evidence folder"]. After a reload the editor showed description="Independent partial-save probe IND81T2F" and Task 2="Open the evidence folder", exactly the mixed state the guide tells the reader to inspect. The retry saved: ["Confirm scope with the requester (revised)","Open the evidence folder (retry probe)"].

steps.action: An archived Matter type takes its template out of creation, and an invalid template is refused
steps.actual: Naming this template on a different Matter type answered 400: {"type":"about:blank","title":"The template must be live and belong to the selected matter type.","status":400,"detail":"The template must be live and belong to the selected matter type.","instance":". After archiving "Ind template type IND81T2F" the creation dialog no longer offered it (offered=false), and creating on the archived type answered 400: {"type":"about:blank","title":"The matter type must be a live matter type.","status":400,"detail":"The matter type must be a live matter type.","instance":"/api/v1/matters"}. Restore put the type back so a live type and matching template can be chosen again.
